description.value: Uptown Pizza is a Salt Spring Group restaurant anchored in the busy Uptown district of Ganges, serving house-made pizzas built on fresh-made dough and marinara with real mozzarella, plus burgers, wings, and Kelly's homemade desserts. A garden-view seating area makes it a pleasant stop to watch the activity of one of Salt Spring Island's most active commercial strips. The restaurant is locally owned and operated as part of a multi-venue group with deep roots on the island.

address.value: 324 Lower Ganges Road, Salt Spring Island, BC V8K2V7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at saltspringgroup.com/uptown-pizza confirms Uptown Pizza is an active, operating restaurant in Salt Spring Island's Uptown district, part of the locally owned Salt Spring Group; the full menu and business description are present.
